biggest_catch: The bonus requires $5,000+ in ACH deposits OR 15 debit card purchases within 90 days, plus scheduling a Merchant Processing consultation and a Treasury Management consultation after opening - the consultations are mandatory steps, not optional freebies.
catches: New business customers only; one bonus per customer.
Must mention promo code 'GROW' when contacting the local branch or treasury manager.
Within 90 days of opening: receive $5,000 or more in ACH deposits OR initiate 15 debit card purchases.
Scheduling a Merchant Processing consultation and a Treasury Management consultation after account opening is a required step of the offer.
Eligible accounts: Business Growth, Business Analysis, Business Relationship, or Community Benefit.
The 60-day free trial of select Treasury Management Services (ACH Origination, Wire Origination, Positive Pay, Remote Deposit Capture) is a trial - ongoing services may carry fees after the trial.
No fixed expiry on the page - offer subject to change/withdrawal at any time; verify the promo is still live before acting.
Bonus is taxable income (standard bank-bonus tax treatment).
Arizona footprint; branch or treasury-manager contact required - not a fully online signup.
